scientific_integrity: Finite-state rational and numerical checks reproduce 688 assertions; analytic reasoning proves the infinite statements. Review is self-review, not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The critical-loss expansion assumes fixed c>0, \(p=c/n\), n>c; no uniform moving-c claim.
The rate of mean completion time is proved, not its precise multiplicative prefactor or distributional limit.
Historical priority remains qualified by unindexed or inaccessible general thinning and metastability literature.
title: Exact stationary coupon-subset moments and sharp critical-loss completion exponent
